apply: git apply, in order, to a clean checkout of the commit above; each file's SHA-256 is checked first (scripts/m2/prepare-api-source.sh)

patches.reason: A refused RabbitMQ connection ended the harness (review finding R2, PC-NUQ-CONNECT).
tests: M2-B01 broker outage with no restart policy

patches.reason: After a broker restart the listener was never re-established while the process survived (review finding R1, upstream #4244 / PR #4263).
tests: M2-B01 listen queue has one consumer within 60 s and a new synchronous scrape returns

patches.reason: The engine registration and result translation spec §8.1 requires; every page acquisition goes to the retrieval service.
symbols: apps/api/src/scraper/scrapeURL/engines/index.ts Engine, engines, engineHandlers, engineMRTs, engineOptions, buildFallbackList

patches.reason: File downloads and map's redirect resolution fetched directly with the core's own dispatcher (spec §8.4).
Search fell back to DuckDuckGo over the home connection whenever SearXNG was unset or empty (evidence/M0/source-review.json S15).
The upstream Dockerfile floats every base image, the Rust toolchain and the crate graph, and downloads the FoundationDB client unchecked (decisions D4, D6).

A search backend failure became an empty result at three layers: searxng_search and search both returned {} on any error, and patch 0005 returned {} when SearXNG had no results (review finding S6, spec §13).
tests: M5-S01 typed search outcomes against the real SearXNG
M5-S02 search through REST and MCP alike

patches.reason: Native PDF parsing returned empty markdown as success for a scan-only document, had no page cap, and fell back to a pdf-parse whose bundled pdf.js 1.10 refuses some valid files; spec §15 asks for native parsing first, typed refusals and a budgeted complex-document fallback.
tests: M5-D01 every document class through the core
M5-D02 the complex-document fallback and its credits
